about: The owner's exception 1 to the v8 freeze (2026-10-21, granted after the v8 baseline run 20261021T084452Z_refseq97-90ec1fbc): gate/declared_v8_rt.json's entries unchanged, plus N-realrep-0023 set aside on the MCP access path, whose cold execution's answer the test client lost; read by policy_v8_rtp_mcp_x1.json and policy_v8_rt_mcp_x1.json. The frozen v8 policies (policy_v8_rtp_mcp.json, policy_v8_rt_mcp.json and this file's source) are unchanged. Owner-declared entries of the v8 deploy gates (gate_policy.py --declared), read by both v8 policies: policy_v8_rt_mcp.json (POST /resolve, POST /traverse, GET /traverse/capabilities) and policy_v8_rtp_mcp.json (the same routes and POST /pattern), pinned to manifest/suite_v8.json as the owner's freeze writes it (build_manifest.py --manifest-version 8 --stop-scenarios --freeze): v7's 725 scenarios byte-identical, R-warm-0009..0018, area G and the two stop scenarios. The entries are v7's, unchanged (declared_v7_rt.json: REL-subset-0007 on mcp); area G sets nothing aside (graphlet_not_required and graphlet_service_checks_not_required empty: every planned op call and service check is required). The stop scenarios run on the MCP arm only (direct_not_run): the policy requires no direct execution of them, and with require_agreement false (as in v7) their missing direct reference is no problem (R2-6). Frozen only by the owner's freeze.

exclusions.reason: the owner's exception of 2026-10-21, granted after the v8 baseline: the cold MCP call (r0) got no answer although its answer left the service with status 200 after 3.1 s (12:02:41 UTC; the service's request log and Railway's HTTP log), because the test client's network address changed at that moment; the client gave up after 105 s (runner_error ReadTimeout). The engine answered in 2.5 s, both direct access paths passed, and the scenario re-run alone at 12:45 UTC (run 20261021T124515Z_refseq97-90ec1fbc) passed on direct-local and via MCP with agreeing answers. The warm repeat r1 passed too but is set aside with r0, because the gate judges the MCP pair's agreement per scenario and r0 has no answer to compare

relations_excluded.reason: service-side by design (round 2, the owner's decision 4 of 2026-10-16): its side b, P-modes-0004, sends max_contexts 10,001, which the service refuses at submit by the by-design table's case pattern.max_contexts_above_10000 (pattern_out_of_bounds on caps.max_contexts; the host clamps the value to 10,000 and answers, the service never lowers it), so P-modes-0002's partial list can never be held within P-modes-0004's on the MCP arm (the v5 baseline: inconclusive, http 200 / 400). P-modes-0004's own MCP execution stays required as the named by-design case, and the relation stays required on direct-local, where both sides answer.
